app.name: Vobiz Calling
app.short_description: Make and receive Vobiz calls from the Zendesk top bar, and log them to tickets.
app.long_description:
Vobiz Calling puts a WebRTC softphone in your Zendesk top bar. Agents dial from the panel or straight from a ticket, talk in the browser with no desk phone or extra software, and save the call to the ticket as a private note with duration and a link to the recording.

Outbound calls run with the browser as the originating leg, so audio is negotiated directly between the agent's browser and the Vobiz media server. Every call is recorded for the whole session, and recording links are short-lived and signed — no account credentials ever reach the browser or a ticket comment.

Requires a Vobiz account with a phone number and a SIP endpoint, plus the Vobiz calling backend that holds your account credentials.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Deploy the Vobiz calling backend and note its public HTTPS URL.
2. Install this app and set the Backend URL to that address.
3. Set the Agent identity to the agent key your backend recognises.
4. Open the Vobiz panel in the top bar, sign in with your Vobiz Auth ID and Auth Token, and wait for the status to read Ready.

backend_url.label: Backend URL
backend_url.helpText: The public HTTPS base URL of your Vobiz calling backend, with no trailing slash — for example https://calling.yourcompany.com. This service holds your Vobiz account credentials; the app itself holds none.

agent_id.label: Agent identity
agent_id.helpText: Which agent identity this installation signs in as. Your calling backend maps this value to a SIP endpoint. Each agent needs a different value, or calls ring the wrong person.

registrar_url.label: SIP registrar URL
registrar_url.helpText: SIP-over-WebSocket address of the Vobiz registrar. Leave this alone unless Vobiz support has given you a different one.
